Preserve the same mature Japanese male civil-engineer teacher: short black hair, rectangular black glasses, light beard, white blank safety helmet, navy workwear and tie, yellow safety vest. Use energetic, professional Japanese bookstore POP styling: extremely bold legible Japanese typography, white and yellow with restrained red for the main product, dark colored header, pale illustrated background, strong diagonal accents and crisp outlines. Text occupies left 72%, teacher large on right 27%, holding a stack of printed learning sheets and a red pen. No competing text on the papers. Do not crop the face or any lettering. All meaningful lettering inside x=45..1235 and y=15..655; generous inner clearance for outlines. Biggest hierarchy: qualification and product type; the PDF-download yellow band should be almost as prominent as the headline. Put the author credential in a separate small yellow badge near the teacher. This is a print-ready flat graphic, not a photographed poster or 3D mockup. Do not show a website UI. No logo, brand name, URL, price, exam date, guarantee, medals, or additional words. Render all specified Japanese strings exactly once, no random or repeated text. Use the reference solely for approved appearance and visual style; ignore its old content and PDF counts.

Small separate author badge near the teacher: 「技術士（総監）が制作」. Keep qualification intact. Especially maintain the word 主任技士 versus 技士 where specified.
